# Range of View Studios

> Range of View Studios (ROV Studios) is a creative production agency based in Atlanta, Georgia, specializing in web development, video production, and custom AI automation solutions.

## Services

- [Web Development & Design](https://www.rovstudios.com/web): Custom Next.js websites built for performance, SEO, and conversion. $2,000-$10,000+. 6-8 week delivery.
- [Video Production & Cinematography](https://www.rovstudios.com/video-production): Brand videos, real estate walkthroughs, drone footage (FAA compliant, sub-250g drone), music videos, event coverage. 3-6 week turnaround.
- [AI Automation Solutions](https://www.rovstudios.com/ai-automation): Custom AI systems for lead follow-up, appointment scheduling, customer support, content generation, and workflow automation. 4-8 week delivery. AI-powered workflows using GPT and Claude.

## Case Studies

- [The Bando](https://www.rovstudios.com/casestudy/bando): Website redesign for Atlanta Black history museum and restaurant. 60% bounce rate reduction.
- [DKM Corp](https://www.rovstudios.com/casestudy/dkm): Global digital infrastructure across India, Australia, US, and Dubai.
- [Aysegul Ikna](https://www.rovstudios.com/casestudy/ikna): Luxury sustainable fashion brand digital transformation. 30% sales increase.

## Key Differentiators

- Creative production agency: web, video, and AI under one roof
- Competitive pricing with no hidden fees
- Custom Next.js builds engineered for performance and SEO
- FAA-compliant drone cinematography and editorial-grade video
- AI automation built on GPT and Claude for real business workflows

## Music

Music production, mixing, and mastering is handled by our sister studio, Range of View Music, at https://www.rovmusic.com.
